$comment: The official Rustic Server plugins as published on the Rustic marketplace by the official 'Rustic' account (launcher ADR 0166). Paths are relative to this file. The version of each upload is read from `plugin_manifest` (the API checks it against the .rplugin). Publish with launcher/scripts/official/publish.mjs (see README.md here).

projects.name: Essentials Lite
projects.summary: Spawn, homes, warps, teleport requests, /back, private messages and broadcasts, with warmups and cooldowns.
projects.changelog: First release on the Rustic marketplace.

projects.name: Perms
projects.summary: Permission groups with inheritance, weights, prefixes, wildcards, temporary nodes and promotion tracks.
projects.changelog: First release on the Rustic marketplace.

projects.name: Chat Format
projects.summary: Chat formats with groups and prefixes, colours, mentions, anti-spam, filters, mutes, join and quit lines.
projects.changelog: First release on the Rustic marketplace.

projects.name: Menus
projects.summary: Clickable chest menus: server info, warps, per-player settings and a paginated player list.
projects.changelog: First release on the Rustic marketplace.

projects.name: Mini-game
projects.summary: Arena mini-games, Spleef and King of the Hill: lobby countdown, boss bar, live sidebar, stats and rewards.
projects.changelog: First release on the Rustic marketplace.
